response.prompt: Doping in elite sport is better explained by athletes' individual choices than by pressures within the sporting environment.
response.instruction_initial: Choose the response that best reflects your view.

review.instruction: Review the following information. You'll then respond to the same statement again.

information.title: An organised system
information.body: The 2016 McLaren Independent Investigation for the World Anti-Doping Agency reported an institutionalised doping conspiracy involving athletes and officials across multiple Russian sporting and state organisations. Athletes were operating within an organised infrastructure rather than simply acting as isolated individuals.
information.source_note: WADA — McLaren Independent Investigation Report, Part II (2016).

information.title: Across major competitions
information.body: The same investigation described a systematic and centralised process for manipulating doping controls across several major international competitions, with sample-swapping practices continuing beyond the Sochi 2014 Winter Olympics.
information.source_note: WADA — McLaren Independent Investigation Report, Part II (2016).
